name: pi-unsloth-webtools
description: Pi extension: web_search and web_fetch tools ported from the Unsloth Studio codebase (DuckDuckGo search, SSRF-safe direct fetching, HTML-to-Markdown extraction)
author: YuGiMob

scripts.check:package: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const pkg=require('./package.json');const listed=new Set(pkg.files);const bad=[];for(const f of pkg.files){if(!fs.existsSync(f))bad.push('missing file: '+f)}for(const f of fs.readdirSync('.').filter(f=>f.endsWith('.ts'))){if(!listed.has(f))bad.push('unlisted source: '+f)}if(bad.length){console.error(bad.join('\n'));process.exit(1)}"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run check:package
